title: 分层剪纸插图
prompt: Layered paper-cut illustration of [subject], built with overlapping shapes in soft [color1] and [color2], handcrafted textures, subtle shadows between layers, clean vector edges, centered on a matte cream background, whimsical and modern visual storytelling.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创作分层剪纸插图，以柔和的叠加色彩和清晰矢量边缘，为出版、品牌或儿童媒体打造异想天开且现代的视觉叙事。
